description: Minimal schema contract for run_optimized_task.py output.

top_level_fields.task_id: Stable task id from task file or filename.
top_level_fields.stability: PASS, FLAKY_PASS, STABLE_FAIL, FLAKY_FAIL, ENV_RELATED or PRECHECK_BLOCKED.

attempt_fields.run_dir: Underlying Cucumber debug run dir when available.
attempt_fields.bdd: Parsed bdd_run_summary/runtime sidecar information when available.
